remark: “Shubh Villa Ext.” is a township scheme for plotted development approved under the provisions of the Rajasthan Township Policy 2010. It is hereby proposed to sell both, plots as well as row houses in the project. The row houses may be sold as per the standard design and specifications or may be customized as per the requirements of the client, as may be mutually agreed between the client and the promoter. As per the provisions of the Unified Building Bylaws 2017, building plan approval for row houses is not required since all plots size are less than 250 sq. mtr in the project. As per the Jaipur Development Authority, Jaipur layout plan approved vide letter no. J.D.A./Zone-11/2019/D-1914 dated 04.11.2019. A Remark put on the copy of approved layout plan, for Internal development in the scheme, 12.5 Percent, i.e., 746.20 sq. mtrs. of saleable area comprising 07 residential plots (plot numbers 1, 70 to 75) and retail commercial plots 08 Units meant for retail shops are mortgaged to Jaipur Development Authority, Jaipur. These Plots are not to be sold without permission of Jaipur Development Authority, Jaipur. So in total we have 82 Unit, which comprises of unit number 1-31 and 34-76, in total 74 row houses/plot (Unit) and 8 retail shops. Therefore, it is clarified that the there are no units with number 32 & 33 in the project. The Promoter has made provisions for the overhead and underground water tank in the unit. Water may be sourced by the buyer(s) through tankers or other outside vendors. Parking provision for the individual units has been made within the unit itself. After deposit charges for internal development work, the JDA has released the mortgage plots and has sanctioned the plot no. 1, 70 to 75 and 8 units of retail commercial.
